sources.note: 207 entries on main at inspection; file moved here from playwright-core/src/server. viewport = layout viewport after browser UI; screen = full screen in CSS px.
Google device emulator profiles (Pixel Fold, Pixel 9 Pro Fold, Pixel 10 Pro Fold, Pixel Tablet, Pixel 10 Pro). One pixel-density per profile, applied to the folded region too.

sources.quote: Chrome on Android will no longer resize the Layout Viewport
sources.note: Chrome 108 default interactive-widget=resizes-visual on Android; Safari iOS resizes visual viewport only; Firefox resizes both. No keyboard heights published.
Values computed by the corpus author from the other listed sources; each derived entry states its formula in `derivation`.

logical.derivation: dp = px / (480 / 160) = px / 3: 1280 / 3 = 426.67; 2856 / 3 = 952 (AOSP nexus.xml pixel_10_pro xxhdpi)

usable.derivation: layout_viewport is the Playwright `viewport` (screen minus browser UI); insets 0 = no separate system-inset data published, not a claim of none
layout_viewport is the Playwright `viewport` (screen minus browser UI); insets 0 = no separate system-inset data published, not a claim of none

unknowns.reason: Playwright reports 427 css_px width (1280 / 3 = 426.67 rounded up); the AOSP panel is 1280 px wide. Recorded as published registry value plus derived dp; not a conflict between profiles.
No published or cited measurement. Chrome 108+ default interactive-widget=resizes-visual: the layout viewport keeps its height and visualViewport.height shrinks; measure at test time.
System insets (status bar, navigation bar) and cutout geometry are not published; insets recorded as 0, meaning "not published", not "none".
